name: agent-tollbooth
title: Agent Tollbooth - Autonomous Micro-Payment Gateway & Tools
description: Exposes real-time crypto microstructure alpha signals, deep liquidation cascade stink-bid levels, and CAD/laser mesh geometry validators through an RFC-compliant x402 payment clearing channel on Polygon.

tools.name: get_market_microstructure_alpha
tools.description: Returns institutional market microstructure metrics for crypto assets: 2:1 orderbook depth absorption, derivatives funding rate squeeze skew, and CME weekend gap magnet targets.

tools.name: get_stink_bid_cascade_levels
tools.description: Calculates high-convexity resting limit order depths ('stink bids') sitting below market liquidation clusters (-15% to -35%) to capture violent flash-crash V-reversals.

tools.name: validate_cad_laser_mesh
tools.description: Validates 3D CAD mesh files (STL/OBJ) and 2D vector laser sheets (SVG) for watertight manifold edges, kerf beam offset compensation (0.15mm), and laser toolpath cutting parameters.
